name: Santorini
dek: No 1991–2020 station file. Athens was not used in its place.
paragraphs: Santorini has no row in a Greek 1991–2020 submission, because that submission is not in the NOAA collection. The Athens gap is a different station even if the numbers had been copied, and they were not. A chart or a travel site that names Thira was not used.

The island is on Europe/Athens, the only Greek zone in zone.tab and zone1970.tab. Plugs, currency, and the CDC water note are the national lines. Driving and tipping are blank because no statute and no tourism-office sentence were opened.

climate.caption: No 1991–2020 month table is printed for Santorini. Athens was not substituted.
climate.note: Greece has no folder in the NOAA NCEI Region VI 1991–2020 collection, version 6.6. The HNMS city page that was opened for Elliniko gives 1955–2010, which is not this period, so those figures are not printed. The National Observatory of Athens published a 1991–2020 table for Athens as an image in its February 2021 magazine. A check of the 1961–1990 row in that image against the same institute's HTML table for 1961–1990 did not agree to the tenth of a degree, so the 1991–2020 row was not transcribed. Santorini was not given Athens's numbers. There is no separate Santorini file to cite.
climate.sourceTitle: WMO 1991-2020 Region VI directory (no Greece folder)

plugs.label: Plugs and voltage
plugs.value: Type C and F, 230 V, 50 Hz
plugs.detail: The IEC world-plugs list, in the copy archived on 16 August 2026, shows Greece at the voltage, frequency, and plug types in the figure. A direct download of the live page on 15 November 2026 did not return the list. The archive is the copy that was read.

water.label: Tap water
water.detail: CDC's traveler page for Greece, last reviewed 25 August 2026, does not say whether tap water is safe or unsafe. It says food and water standards around the world vary based on the destination, that standards may also differ within a country, and that risk may change depending on the activity. It points readers to CDC's food and water precautions. This page does not turn that into medical advice.

currency.label: Currency
currency.detail: ISO 4217 lists the currency name Euro and the code EUR for Greece.

timeZone.label: Time zone
timeZone.detail: IANA's zone.tab and zone1970.tab each give Greece one row, Europe/Athens. Athens and Santorini are both on that row. There is no second Greek zone in either file.

entry.label: Official entry requirements
entry.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Greece
entry.note: The foreign ministry's visas section, for foreigners traveling to Greece. We do not restate a visa rule.
